events.verdict: Sengun (HOU) makes illegal contact across Leonard's (LAC) arm, causing him to lose control of the ball.
Collins (LAC) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Lopez (LAC) blocks the shot attempt and the contact to Sengun's (HOU) body prior to the blocked shot is marginal.
Lopez (LAC) briefly grabs Sengun's (HOU) arm, but the marginal contact does not prevent him from getting the rebound.
Mathurin (LAC) lowers his arms and makes illegal contact to Durant's (HOU) arm during the layup attempt.
Leonard (LAC) places his off-arm against Tate (HOU), who loses his balance on his own as he defends the play.
The contact between Thompson (HOU) and Collins (LAC) is incidental as Thompson switches.
Tate (HOU) legally contests Collins' (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Collins (LAC) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Thompson's (HOU) layup attempt.
Dunn (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Lopez (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Sengun's (HOU) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Lopez (LAC) establishes himself in Thompson's (HOU) path prior to the contact.
Eason (HOU) legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Leonard (LAC) swipes down and makes illegal contact to Sengun's (HOU) leg during his shooting motion.
Tate (HOU) jumps into Leonard (LAC) during his shooting motion, initiating more-than-marginal contact.
Dunn (LAC) legally contests Eason's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
